author: rozaru
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000158532

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
all the tyrosine 3-monooxygenases
examples:
ple (Dmel, P18459)
TH (human, P07101)

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
erroneous propagation
The annotation is based on zebrafish th2 (A0A8M2BBY7)
According to PMID: 23754283

> "Two tyrosine hydroxylase genes have been reported in zebrafish. Both genes were cloned based on sequence homology, so they were named tyrosine hydroxylase 1 (th1; Gene ID 30384) and tyrosine hydroxylase 2 (th2; Gene ID 414844), respectively (25). Zebrafish th1 is more similar to mammalian th than th2.”

In turned out that th2 is actually a tryptophan hydroxylase involved in serotonin biosynthesis.
Mammals and fly have a dedicated gene for tryptophan hydroxylase TPH1 (human) and Trhn (fly).
Tyrosine hydroxylase TH or ple are not involved in serotonin biosynthesis.
title: PAINT issue: incorrect propagation of serotonin biosynthetic process to tyrosine 3-monooxygenase
